messages:
incident-bot: Pager — billing-metering: token sync anomaly detected for aggregator 'tokencounter-agg' (us-west-2). Missing token events ~1.9% across 03:00-03:05Z, emitter heartbeat gaps. Auto-escalating to on-call.
ashley (oncall): acknowledged — investigating. pulling emitter and aggregator logs now.
ashley (oncall): quick check — emitter pod tokemitter-5 restarted at 03:02Z repeatedly, backlog queue depth jumped.
sre-jen: seeing the restart too, node reported OOM on that pod and kubelet evicted cache. Replica set shows 2/3 healthy, one in CrashLoopBackOff.
billing-ops: FYI — billing pipeline flagged ~12 customers with overage alerts starting 03:07Z. Some have preliminary charge previews >$50. Holding on automated charge execution for affected subset.
devon (infra): proposing fallback: switch collector stream to backup-emitter (no rolling deploy). I can patch router to route 10% -> fallback to drain backlog.
matt (product): tagging customer-impact — any PII at risk? Also need list of customers to notify if we see confirmed overcharges.
ashley (oncall): running quick recon to quantify token loss. command: ```bash
kubectl logs tokencollector-0 -n billing | grep "drop" | tail -n 50
```
sre-jen: recon shows token-ack latency spike ~120s at 03:02Z, backlog re-enqueue happened but dedupe on aggregator dropped duplicates, causing net loss. I'll trigger replay for the 03:00-03:06 window.
billing-ops: put manual hold on auto-charge and alerting for invoices created between 03:00-03:15Z. Notifying CS to prepare templates.
devon (infra): patching router now: `kubectl -n infra patch cm/routing --patch '{"data":{"collector-route":"backup-emitter"}}'` -> applying 03:12Z :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ashley (oncall): replay job started at 03:14Z: `python tools/replay_tokens.py --window "2024-06-05T03:00:00Z/2024-06-05T03:06:00Z" --target aggregators=tokencounter-agg`
sre-jen: replay completed (partial): delta recon shows ~98.6% restored, remaining ~0.3% variance — running delta-fix job.
billing-ops: confirmed that hold prevented auto-charges. CS has initial email draft, will wait for final reconciliation before outreach. :thumbsup:
ashley (oncall): counts converging to expected baseline, dashboards green for last 6m. Leaving SRE watch for 30m and will handoff.
matt (product): filing follow-up: INC-2024-0615-01 for postmortem and billing reconciliation runbook updates. Need a blameless postmortem and a retro on retry/dedupe logic.
sre-jen: I'll stay monitoring the collector and schedule a rolling restart of tokencollector replicas with increased memory request.
billing-ops: after reconciliation we should run a ledger scrub to ensure no phantom charges. I'll coordinate with finance.
ashley (oncall): handoff -> sre-jen taking over watch; reachable if needed. Thanks team — great cross-team coordination. :white_check_mark:
